---
title: "HDD/Borg"
---

An external HDD with Vorta/Borg provides versioned, encrypted backups of local
workstation data. It complements GitHub and Nextcloud: synchronization and
remote Git hosting do not replace an independently recoverable backup.

Keep the drive disconnected except while backing up, checking, or restoring
data. Configure or reconnect its repository, sources, retention policy, and
schedule through [Borg/Vorta](borg_vorta.qmd), then follow the recurring
[backup routine](backup.qmd).
